name: Yankalilla
reason: southaustralia.com destination page names the Yankalilla District Historical Museum, Christ Church (1857, Shrine of Our Lady of Yankalilla) and a heritage trail; enough for a town stop.

name: Encounter Bay
reason: Searched Wikivoyage and board: Wikivoyage folds it into Victor Harbor; no separate named sight. Near-duplicate of Victor Harbor / The Bluff / Nakurami Kondoli Whale Lookout.

name: Milang
reason: Lakeside town named by southaustralia.com with Port Milang Historical Railway Museum (locomotives, simulator, light railway centre), heritage-listed jetty and historical walk.

name: Currency Creek
reason: Searched board and Wikivoyage: only a roadside park, a wetland and a viaduct plus cellar doors; no single named half-hour draw, and cellar doors are not spots.

name: Ingalalla Falls
reason: Board lists it; easy ~700 m return walk in Second Valley Forest to a two-tier waterfall and rock pool with picnic tables; a named waterfall walk.

name: Moana Sands Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA page and board (lookouts): coastal dunes with Kaurna heritage, hooded plover habitat; small park but a named conservation park with trails.

name: Cox Scrub Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA and southaustralia.com attraction page: three loop walks (Quarry 3.5 km, Stringybark 4 km, Emu Wren 8.5 km), free.

name: Nangawooka Flora Reserve
reason: Board lists it only with lawn gardens; small flora reserve visited for spring wildflowers, no visitor page found beyond the list; fails the half-hour-anytime test.

name: Tolderol Game Reserve
reason: southaustralia.com and Parks SA: well-known migratory wader birdwatching site on Lake Alexandrina, lookout and picnic area, wetlands reopened Aug 2025 (note: seasonal best Sep-Mar, short duck-hunting season).

name: Waitpinga Conservation Park
reason: Not on the board list; searched board and southaustralia.com, no visitor page naming it; the coast is covered by Newland Head Conservation Park and Heysen Trail.

name: Talisker Conservation Park
reason: southaustralia.com lists Talisker Mine Ruins, and Walking SA describes a 1.4 km interpretive circuit through the 1860s silver-lead mine ruins with lookout option to Kangaroo Island, about an hour.

name: Eric Bonython Conservation Park
reason: Searched board and southaustralia.com: no visitor page or named feature; no counted source.

name: Onkaparinga River Recreation Park
reason: Parks SA page: estuary wetlands with boardwalks, kayaking, fishing and shared trails, open daily; board lists it.

name: Nakurami Kondoli Whale Lookout
reason: Free whale-watching platform at Kings Beach on the Heysen Trail, named by board (two pages) and southaustralia.com.

name: Kleinigs Hill Lookout
reason: Council-run lookout above Victor Harbor named by southaustralia.com and the board.

name: The Hindmarsh River Walking Trail
reason: Named river walk at Victor Harbor on two board pages; a guide-named walk, second tier.

name: The Inman River Trail
reason: Named river trail at Victor Harbor with barbecue, toilets and carpark on two board pages; second-tier walk.

name: McLaren Vale Cellar Door Tree Trail
reason: A trail linking cellar doors (businesses), not a place; board lists only the cellar-door amenity.

name: Myponga Beach
reason: Surf beach with carpark and toilets named by the board; second-tier beach a guide names.

name: Fishery Beach
reason: Beach near Cape Jervis named by the board nature page; second-tier beach (thin detail, one source).

name: Tunkalilla Beach
reason: Board lists it; Weekend Notes/Yankalilla guides name the Tunkalilla Beach walk for seals and dolphins; remote Southern Ocean beach.

name: Morgans Beach
reason: southaustralia.com attraction page: 800 m sandy cove beneath 50 m glacial cliffs at Cape Jervis, clifftop lookout, reef exploring; board also lists it.

name: Lady Bay Beach
reason: Adjacent to and the same beach stretch as Normanville Beach, which the board lists separately; near-duplicate (rule 3).

name: Goolwa Beach
reason: Board lists the surf beach at Goolwa near the Murray Mouth with carpark and cafe; second-tier beach.

name: Red Poles
reason: Wikivoyage See and the McLaren Vale board arts pages name this long-running gallery (Indigenous and SA artists), restaurant and B&B; free to browse, ~1 hr. Case against: part cafe/business.

name: Magpie Springs
reason: For: Wikivoyage See, board arts page and southaustralia.com name the free art gallery (Avril Thomas) among vineyard gardens with wildlife. Against: weekends-only, gallery tied to a cellar door, mixed business.

name: Newman's Horseradish Farm
reason: Working farm shop with tastings; board lists it under shopping and tours, a short stop that is mainly retail, not a distinct place to see.

name: Animal Farm Goolwa
reason: Open family animal park in Goolwa, named by the board's tours and wildlife-encounters pages; feeding and animal encounters fill an hour or more.

name: Victor Harbor National Trust Museum
reason: Heritage museum in Victor Harbor listed by the board's heritage and arts pages (two counted sources); open to the public, a half-hour or more of local history.

name: Gilbert's Motor Museum
reason: Board heritage page calls it a must for motoring enthusiasts: century-old family garage turned museum in 2019 with Buicks, Holdens and bikes; open to the public.

name: Goolwa Motor Museum
reason: Wikivoyage Goolwa See lists this small museum of locally made SA cars at 45 Gardiner St; a different museum in a different town from Gilbert's. Small, but a guide names it.

name: Signal Point Experience Centre
reason: Interactive interpretive centre on Goolwa's wharf precinct about the Murray Mouth and river; board arts page lists it and Wikivoyage describes the precinct with its map of the lake system.

name: Murray Mouth
reason: Wikivoyage only says the mouth is seen from Hindmarsh Island in Coorong National Park; no visitor page names a viewing place or something to do, and it is not a distinct visitable spot (Signal Point covers the interpretation).

name: Willunga Courthouse and Slate Museums
reason: Historic 1854 courthouse with slate museum open to visitors in Willunga, listed on the board's heritage and outdoor pages.

name: Strathalbyn Districts Museum and Heritage Centre
reason: Local history museum in Strathalbyn named by the board's heritage and arts pages; interactive displays suit a half-hour visit in a heritage town.

name: Milang Railway Museum
reason: Tiny volunteer-run museum listed only on one board heritage page; short visit and one counted source (marginal needs two).

name: Cape Jervis Lighthouse
reason: Searched the board's attractions pages and Wikivoyage Fleurieu: no counted source names it; a small unstaffed light with Wikipedia only.

name: Starfish Hill Wind Farm
reason: Operating wind farm with no visitor offering and no counted source; Wikipedia only.
